findings.note: In his last game before this one (Nov 2 loss to the Lakers), Antetokounmpo had 12 rebounds and 7 assists in 34 minutes, a total of 19, which beats the 17.5 line. The related-news list also shows triple-doubles on Oct 28 and Oct 30 and a game where he fouled out after 25 minutes.
In the Oct 30 blowout win over the Pacers, Antetokounmpo had 17 rebounds and 10 assists in 31 minutes, a total of 27, which clears 17.5 easily even with fewer minutes than usual.

Antetokounmpo had 18 rebounds in the Heat's first win, over Atlanta, so he cleared the line on rebounds alone. The report also notes that Bam Adebayo is rebounding alongside him and hasn't cut into his rebound numbers.
